verdict.rationale: Xero explicitly markets bank connection and daily automated reconciliation via its AI tool JAX ('Connect your bank accounts to Xero. Let JAX categorize and match transactions'), directly matching the story. However, evidence lacks detail on daily-import cadence, breadth/number of supported banks, or setup mechanics, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability. Missing for 10: specifics on import frequency/reliability, list of supported banks, and independent user confirmation of automatic daily sync.
